# Constraint2D

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of the joints between two `Part2D`s. Use joints to build a rope bridge, a hinged door or a swinging lamp.

A 2D joint connects two parts at a point on each. Each point is given in meters from the center of its part, in the part's own frame. A joint that cannot hold does nothing and is not an error: one with a part missing or not in the world, or one between two anchored parts.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Anchor0` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The position of the joint on `Part0`, in meters from the part's center, in the part's own frame. It turns with the part. |
| `Anchor1` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The position of the joint on `Part1`, in meters from the part's center, in the part's own frame. It turns with the part. |
| `CollideConnected` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the two parts still collide with each other. Turn it off for the links of a chain or a limb, where the parts overlap at the joint. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the joint holds. A disabled joint stays in the world and does nothing. |
| `Part0` | `Part2D?` | — | read/write | The first of the two parts the joint connects. |
| `Part1` | `Part2D?` | — | read/write | The second of the two parts the joint connects. |
